ai-workforce v1.0.0

- Initial release: transforms an OpenClaw agent into an autonomous AI Chief to operate businesses.
- Implements trust-based autonomy for safe action management, with promotion/demotion logic per action category.
- Introduces structured knowledge management through an organized bank/ directory and shared knowledge for worker delegation.
- Supports multiple worker delegation patterns: single, parallel, sequential, and persistent.
- Enforces cost guardrails and operational limits for memory and expenses.
- Automates daily, weekly, and monthly reflection cycles to drive self-improvement and memory maintenance.
- Establishes strict boundaries between worker and Chief knowledge with clear rules for promoting/demoting organizational memory.
